evidence_notes: Main commits 27cacfa93439f91bd7e0afafcf4345493cefc335 and c9b9e3d65e6a53af99b8ca7e7e6377edb85a7fa4 add a SQLite WAL journal/outbox/command-dedupe primitive and focused persistence tests.

Focused standalone persistence suite passed 5/5 locally before commit. This is not full WP-05 qualification: crash-boundary integration, projection rebuild equivalence, migration rollback and exact-head CI remain open.
Main commit eb4de12fe4acd438a78abc5f7b72bba7ef90bc27 includes recovery and CLI regression coverage on top of the simulated MVP vertical slice.
Main commit f8528b4241c232baaeb90590ae294cdd56dcd015 hardens checkpoint/evidence persistence ordering and restart repair behavior.
Main commit db5332ab1c3edc712e0a7765411d5de2be8cb175 fixes CLI status and multi-episode execution.

Main commit 345c7fc5fd16398f905f7f0af6d3fa058a68fed5 introduced a deterministic network-free vertical slice spanning market input, decision, risk admission, durable intent, simulated execution, economic ledger, reconciliation, portfolio valuation, restart and learning evidence.
The MVP deliberately cannot place a live order. Simulated-provider evidence is not qualification of Bybit, Kraken, WhiteBIT, Binance, IBKR or Alpaca.
The current MVP economic ledger is a bounded demonstration, not completion of WP-14 through WP-20 or derivative/corporate-action accounting.
Economic edge remains unproven. No backtest, paper result or simulated result is treated as evidence of expected profitability.

PR head 4f5ed15d1afff0c20bc2e71672e152d78bef899e completed both repository verification and the Windows/Ubuntu baseline matrix successfully. This is useful cross-platform evidence but is not an exact-head qualification of the latest main commit.
Canonical contract generation/codegen, release dependency locks, provider qualification, Windows packaging, NVDA qualification, recovery release evidence and bounded-real qualification remain open.
The repository control mode is PARALLEL_ISOLATED_WORKTREES. The Git-backed registry primitive exists, but the deployed authenticated claim service and protected publication path remain unqualified.
